Create documentation. Please specify what you want documented (product, API, onboarding, architecture, release notes, etc.), intended audience, and any existing materials/links to base it on.

Document Type: document
Title: Documentation Session
Outline:
1. Overview
2. Audience & Goals
3. Prerequisites
4. Setup / Installation
5. Usage / Workflows
6. Configuration
7. API / Interfaces (if applicable)

container_info.reasoning: The application description is strictly documentation-focused (document creation, outlines, changelog, etc.) rather than a web/mobile/desktop app or API. The container already includes documentation tooling such as sphinx and mkdocs, and MkDocs is a lightweight, headless-friendly static documentation generator written in Python that fits the described use case (producing product/API/onboarding/architecture docs). MkDocs uses minimal dependencies, works well in a headless container, and produces static site output that can be served or exported. The environment already provides python3 and pip, making MkDocs the most suitable minimal framework.
alternative_frameworks: Static site using plain Markdown + hugo
Plain Markdown files (no framework) with simple script to render/preview
requirements: Install mkdocs via pip: pip install mkdocs
Optional minimal theme: pip install mkdocs-material (only if Material theme is desired)
Project structure: docs/ (Markdown files), mkdocs.yml (site config)
Serve (headless validation): mkdocs build (no dev server required) or mkdocs serve for local testing if port forwarding available
Git (already present) for versioning source docs
Lightweight testing: spellchecker linter (optional) e.g., pip install mkdocs-awesome-pages-plugin or markdownlint via npm if needed; otherwise basic CI can run mkdocs build to validate

Headless configuration: ensure MKDOCS_CONFIG environment variable or use mkdocs.yml in repository root; no production webserver required (serve static files with simple container copy or use existing lightweight file server if needed)

steps.name: environment - verify python3, manage mkdocs safely, persist env idempotently
steps.description: Verify python3 and pip, detect effective user for user-local pip bin path, ensure mkdocs is present (image includes mkdocs) and only upgrade if MKDOCS_VERSION mismatches or MKDOCS_UPGRADE=true. Optionally install mkdocs-material when MKDOCS_MATERIAL=true. Validate MKDOCS_CONFIG points to a plausible mkdocs.yml and persist it idempotently in /etc/profile.d without clobbering existing files. Persist user-local bin PATH only for the effective user and only when needed. Source created /etc/profile.d files into current shell so later steps see changes. Operates in workspace /tmp/kavia/workspace/code-generation/documentation-session-236924-236925/Documentation.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/tmp/kavia/workspace/code-generation/documentation-session-236924-236925/Documentation}"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "python3 missing" >&2; exit 2; }
if ! python3 -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "python3 pip missing" >&2; exit 3; fi
PIP_CMD="python3 -m pip"
# Determine effective user for user-local bin
EUSER="${SUDO_USER:-$(id -un)}"
USER_HOME=$(getent passwd "$EUSER" | cut -d: -f6 2>/dev/null || echo "${HOME:-/root}")
LOCAL_BIN="$USER_HOME/.local/bin"
# Helper for pip installs
pip_install(){ if ! $PIP_CMD "$@"; then echo "pip failed: $*" >&2; exit 4; fi }
# Detect mkdocs and compare versions
INSTALLED_VER=""
if command -v mkdocs >/dev/null 2>&1; then INSTALLED_VER="$(mkdocs --version 2>/dev/null | awk -F' ' '{print $NF}' || true)"; fi
if [ -n "${MKDOCS_VERSION:-}" ]; then
  if [ "$INSTALLED_VER" = "${MKDOCS_VERSION}" ]; then
    : # correct version
  else
    pip_install install --upgrade "mkdocs==${MKDOCS_VERSION}"
  fi
else
  if [ -z "$INSTALLED_VER" ]; then
    pip_install install --upgrade mkdocs
  else
    if [ "${MKDOCS_UPGRADE:-false}" = "true" ]; then pip_install install --upgrade mkdocs; fi
  fi
fi
if [ "${MKDOCS_MATERIAL:-false}" = "true" ]; then pip_install install --upgrade mkdocs-material; fi
# Validate MKDOCS_CONFIG if provided: must be a file named mkdocs.yml or yaml variant
if [ -n "${MKDOCS_CONFIG:-}" ]; then
  if [ ! -f "${MKDOCS_CONFIG}" ]; then echo "MKDOCS_CONFIG provided but not a file: ${MKDOCS_CONFIG}" >&2; exit 5; fi
  base=$(basename "${MKDOCS_CONFIG}")
  case "$base" in
    mkdocs.yml|mkdocs.yaml|*.yml|*.yaml) :;;
    *) echo "MKDOCS_CONFIG does not look like mkdocs config (expected mkdocs.yml/mkdocs.yaml): $base" >&2; exit 6;;
  esac
  # write idempotent profile.d entry (do not clobber existing files)
  target_dir=/etc/profile.d
  sudo mkdir -p "$target_dir"
  key_file="$target_dir/99-mkdocs-config-${EUSER}.sh"
  ESCAPED_VAL="$(printf "%s" "${MKDOCS_CONFIG}" | sed "s/'/'\\''/g")"
  if [ -f "$key_file" ]; then
    if ! sudo grep -q "MKDOCS_CONFIG=""$ESCAPED_VAL"" "$key_file" 2>/dev/null; then
      sudo bash -c "cat > '$key_file' <<'EOF'
# MkDocs config (user-specific)
export MKDOCS_CONFIG='${ESCAPED_VAL}'
EOF"
      sudo chmod 644 "$key_file"
    fi
  else
    sudo bash -c "cat > '$key_file' <<'EOF'
# MkDocs config (user-specific)
export MKDOCS_CONFIG='${ESCAPED_VAL}'
EOF"
    sudo chmod 644 "$key_file"
  fi
  # source it for current shell
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "$key_file"
fi
# Persist user-local bin for effective user if it exists or if pip likely installs there
if [ -d "$LOCAL_BIN" ] || $PIP_CMD show pip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  target_dir=/etc/profile.d
  sudo mkdir -p "$target_dir"
  path_file="$target_dir/99-python-user-bin-${EUSER}.sh"
  entry="export PATH=\"$LOCAL_BIN:\$PATH\""
  if [ -f "$path_file" ]; then
    if ! sudo grep -Fq "$LOCAL_BIN" "$path_file" 2>/dev/null; then
      sudo bash -c "cat > '$path_file' <<'EOF'
# Add user local pip bin to PATH for $EUSER
$entry
EOF"
      sudo chmod 644 "$path_file"
    fi
  else
    sudo bash -c "cat > '$path_file' <<'EOF'
# Add user local pip bin to PATH for $EUSER
$entry
EOF"
    sudo chmod 644 "$path_file"
  fi
  # source for current shell
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "$path_file"
fi
# Final mkdocs availability check
if ! command -v mkdocs >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "mkdocs not available after setup" >&2; exit 7; fi
# expose mkdocs version
mkdocs --version || true
exit 0

steps.name: scaffolding - create MkDocs project, README, .gitignore, and helper scripts
steps.description: Create a minimal MkDocs project in the authoritative workspace: docs/index.md, mkdocs.yml, .gitignore (ignores site/), README.md, and helper scripts build.sh and serve.sh that accept SITE_DIR and MKDOCS_CONFIG overrides via env vars. Validate mkdocs availability (source env from /etc/profile.d if present) before writing scripts. Optionally initialize git and commit if INIT_GIT=true; when committing, set local repo user.name/email from GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL to avoid depending on global config. Operates in workspace /tmp/kavia/workspace/code-generation/documentation-session-236924-236925/Documentation.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/tmp/kavia/workspace/code-generation/documentation-session-236924-236925/Documentation}"
# Source profile.d to pick up MKDOCS_CONFIG/PATH if env step wrote them
if [ -d /etc/profile.d ]; then for f in /etc/profile.d/99-mkdocs-config-* /etc/profile.d/99-python-user-bin-* 2>/dev/null; do [ -f "$f" ] && source "$f" || true; done; fi
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/docs" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Minimal content
cat > "$WORKSPACE/docs/index.md" <<'MD'
# Welcome

This is a minimal MkDocs site scaffolded for automated development validation.
MD
cat > "$WORKSPACE/mkdocs.yml" <<'YML'
site_name: Documentation
nav:
  - Home: index.md
YML
cat > "$WORKSPACE/.gitignore" <<'GIT'
site/
*.pyc
__pycache__/
.env
venv/
GIT
cat > "$WORKSPACE/README.md" <<'R'
# Documentation project

Use ./build.sh to build the site and ./serve.sh to serve locally. Set SITE_DIR or MKDOCS_CONFIG env vars to override defaults.
R
# Helper scripts accept overrides
cat > "$WORKSPACE/build.sh" <<'B'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/tmp/kavia/workspace/code-generation/documentation-session-236924-236925/Documentation}"
SITE_DIR="${SITE_DIR:-site}"
if [ -n "${MKDOCS_CONFIG:-}" ]; then mkdocs build --config-file "${MKDOCS_CONFIG}" --site-dir "$SITE_DIR"; else mkdocs build --site-dir "$SITE_DIR"; fi
B
cat > "$WORKSPACE/serve.sh" <<'S'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/tmp/kavia/workspace/code-generation/documentation-session-236924-236925/Documentation}"
SITE_DIR="${SITE_DIR:-site}"
PORT="${PORT:-8000}"
# serve the built site
python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory "${WORKSPACE}/${SITE_DIR}"
S
chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/build.sh" "$WORKSPACE/serve.sh"
# ensure mkdocs is available before finishing
if ! command -v mkdocs >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "mkdocs not available; run env-001" >&2; exit 5; fi
# Optional git init and commit with local config to avoid relying on global config
if [ "${INIT_GIT:-false}" = "true" ] && [ ! -d "$WORKSPACE/.git" ]; then
  git -C "$WORKSPACE" init --quiet
  if [ -n "${GIT_AUTHOR_NAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL:-}" ]; then
    git -C "$WORKSPACE" config user.name "${GIT_AUTHOR_NAME}"
    git -C "$WORKSPACE" config user.email "${GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL}"
  fi
  git -C "$WORKSPACE" add . && git -C "$WORKSPACE" commit -m "scaffold: initial mkdocs site" || { echo "git commit failed" >&2; exit 6; }
fi
exit 0

steps.name: dependencies - optional spellcheck QA tooling (select and pinable)
steps.description: Optionally install a documentation spellcheck plugin when INSTALL_SPELLCHECK=true. Support a small ordered list of common plugins (default priority: mkdocs-spelling, mkdocs-spellcheck, mkdocs-spellcheck-plugin) and allow SPELLCHECK_PKG to override/pin exact package[==version]. If SPELLCHECK_VERSION is provided, verify compatibility with installed package and upgrade if mismatched. Operates in workspace /tmp/kavia/workspace/code-generation/documentation-session-236924-236925/Documentation.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/tmp/kavia/workspace/code-generation/documentation-session-236924-236925/Documentation}"
PIP_CMD="python3 -m pip"
if [ "${INSTALL_SPELLCHECK:-false}" != "true" ]; then exit 0; fi
# determine package to install
if [ -n "${SPELLCHECK_PKG:-}" ]; then
  candidates=("${SPELLCHECK_PKG}")
else
  candidates=(mkdocs-spelling mkdocs-spellcheck mkdocs-spellcheck-plugin)
fi
for pkg in "${candidates[@]}"; do
  if $PIP_CMD show "$pkg" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    INST_VER="$($PIP_CMD show "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | awk -F": " '/^Version:/{print $2;exit}')"
    if [ -n "${SPELLCHECK_VERSION:-}" ]; then
      if [ "$INST_VER" = "${SPELLCHECK_VERSION}" ]; then exit 0; fi
      $PIP_CMD install --upgrade "${pkg}==${SPELLCHECK_VERSION}" && exit 0 || continue
    else
      exit 0
    fi
  else
    if [ -n "${SPELLCHECK_VERSION:-}" ]; then
      if $PIP_CMD install --upgrade "${pkg}==${SPELLCHECK_VERSION}"; then exit 0; else continue; fi
    else
      if $PIP_CMD install --upgrade "$pkg"; then exit 0; else continue; fi
    fi
  fi
done
echo "spellcheck plugin installation failed for candidates: ${candidates[*]}" >&2
exit 7

steps.description: Build the static site (uses build step), start a lightweight Python HTTP server, verify index.html responds with retries/backoff, then stop server. Operates in workspace /tmp/kavia/workspace/code-generation/documentation-session-236924-236925/Documentation.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/tmp/kavia/workspace/code-generation/documentation-session-236924-236925/Documentation}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# ensure environment visible
if [ -d /etc/profile.d ]; then for f in /etc/profile.d/99-mkdocs-config-* /etc/profile.d/99-python-user-bin-* 2>/dev/null; do [ -f "$f" ] && source "$f" || true; done; fi
SITE_DIR="${SITE_DIR:-site}"
PORT=${PORT:-8001}
# default bind to 0.0.0.0 for in-container validation; override with BIND env
BIND=${BIND:-0.0.0.0}
# Build site (reuse mkdocs invocation)
BUILD_LOG="/tmp/mkdocs-build-$$.log"
if [ -n "${MKDOCS_CONFIG:-}" ]; then
  mkdocs build --config-file "${MKDOCS_CONFIG}" --site-dir "$SITE_DIR" >"$BUILD_LOG" 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 "$BUILD_LOG" >&2; echo "validation: build failed" >&2; exit 7; }
else
  mkdocs build --site-dir "$SITE_DIR" >"$BUILD_LOG" 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 "$BUILD_LOG" >&2; echo "validation: build failed" >&2; exit 7; }
fi
[ -f "$WORKSPACE/$SITE_DIR/index.html" ] || { echo "validation: index.html missing" >&2; exit 8; }
HTTP_LOG="/tmp/mkdocs-http-$$.log"
python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --bind "$BIND" --directory "$WORKSPACE/$SITE_DIR" >"$HTTP_LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# readiness: retry curl until available
ATTEMPTS=15
SLEEP=1
CURL_HOST=127.0.0.1
if [ "$BIND" = "0.0.0.0" ]; then CURL_HOST=127.0.0.1; else CURL_HOST="$BIND"; fi
for i in $(seq 1 $ATTEMPTS); do
  if curl -sSf -o /dev/null "http://${CURL_HOST}:${PORT}/index.html" 2>/dev/null; then
    break
  fi
  if [ "$i" -eq "$ATTEMPTS" ]; then
    echo "validation: server did not respond after $ATTEMPTS attempts" >&2
    tail -n 200 "$HTTP_LOG" >&2 || true
    kill "$PID" || true
    wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 10
  fi
  sleep $SLEEP
done
# stop server
kill "$PID" || true
wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "validation: site built at $WORKSPACE/$SITE_DIR and served successfully (index reachable)"
exit 0
